Highlander Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 118.22% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Highlander Capital Management Llc bought 9,375 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.03% with the market. The institutional investor held 17,305 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.16M, up from 7,930 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Highlander Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $328.32 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.18% or $0.22 during the last trading session, reaching $122.41. About 5.24 million shares traded. Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) has declined 4.75% since June 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.32% the S&P500.
